' ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text),'')) h FROM public.data_entry_storage_receipts t) x),'config',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY signature),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT oid::regprocedure::text signature,md5(prosrc) source,coalesce(proacl::text,'DEFAULT') proacl,coalesce(proconfig,ARRAY[]::text[]) proconfig,proowner FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (proname LIKE 'data_entry%' OR proname IN ('standalone_attempt_gate_333','standalone_attempts_333_internal'))) x),'core_open',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_entry_settings WHERE preparation_validated OR execute_validated),'attempt_open',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.standalone_attempt_settings_333 WHERE enabled),'allowlist_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_entry_pilot8_allowlist)) baseline
